title: SocialEngagementRawEvent
description: Raw un-normalized social engagement event published by upstream collectors or REST ingestion fallback

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this raw event

source_type.description: Channel categorization as defined in PRD Section 4.2

agent_job_id.description: Optional target agent job if this collection was scoped to a specific job

client_id.description: Optional registered client ID for external ingested feeds

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the event occurred on the source platform

payload.description: Raw platform-specific payload containing post, comment, and engagement details
